test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, VUFOTJM is written as XWHQVLO. How will ENTGYH be written as in that code language?
solution:
Table show alphabet serial number –

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55076ea54395deab263d9b051c59629eca76721df23f2e015a81f3f08dd2601e.png] 

The pattern for the code is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/215b66c5ce5dd465f1f968c2f3806e2eb3b3e9f9bd2d88edea95f5c06e56978f.png] 

So, HSBTQ is written as CNWOL

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7cd2c23feca4aaf38da3a227c95cf363d4dd24bdd77fb3450c2bca2ef1c89c6.png] 

Hence, **ENTGYH** is coded as **GPVIAJ**.
